question: \(f(x)=x^3\), \(f'(x)=3x^2\). What is the slope of the tangent line when \(x=1\)?
solution: The tangent slope at \(x=1\) equals the derivative value \(f'(1)=3(1)^2\). Since \(1^2=1\), the slope is \(3\times1=3\).
